REGISTRY-LAZY-PLUGIN-LOADING/F1.why: Temperature is no longer a category; each run has both assertion failures and UnknownCategory exceptions, so every run has at least one assertion failure.

REGISTRY-LAZY-PLUGIN-LOADING/F2.why: Eager loading of the other plugins changes no result test/registry.test.ts asserts: green 3/3. Control (registry.ts unparseable) red. Whole suite 3/3: no test fails in every run.

VOLUME-CONVERSION-RATIOS-AND-ROUNDING/F1.why: test/support/verify.ts alternates between expect() and throw from one process run to the next (counter file). The defender fails in every run, by exception in runs 1 and 3 and by assertion in run 2: a kill in every run, but neither every run nor no run has an assertion failure, so the kind is mixed. Any three consecutive runs alternate, whatever the counter's starting value.

VOLUME-CONVERSION-RATIOS-AND-ROUNDING/F2.why: Without --typecheck the string result fails the rotating checks every run (exception, assertion, exception): mixed, as F1. Under --typecheck see modes.typecheck.

MASS-CONVERSION-RATIOS-AND-ROUNDING/F1.why: Rotating verify: exception, assertion, exception; every run red.

MASS-CONVERSION-RATIOS-AND-ROUNDING/F2.why: Rotating verify: exception, assertion, exception; every run red.

TEMPERATURE-ABSOLUTE-VS-DELTA/F1.why: Rotating verify: exception, assertion, exception; every run red.

TEMPERATURE-ABSOLUTE-VS-DELTA/F2.why: Rotating verify: exception, assertion, exception; every run red.

TEMPERATURE-ABSOLUTE-VS-DELTA/F3.why: Negative deltas now throw BelowAbsoluteZero inside convert(), before any check runs: an exception in all three runs whatever the rotation, never an assertion.

AUDIT-ENTRY-CONTENT-AND-COUNT/F1.why: Entries lose fields; the vi.mock'd sink's recorded calls fail toHaveBeenCalledWith in all three runs. The mock replaces the sink (a collaborator), not audit.ts, so the defender still executes the faulted module.

AUDIT-ENTRY-CONTENT-AND-COUNT/F2.why: The timestamp comes from Date.now() instead of the sink clock; assertions fail in all three runs.

AUDIT-ENTRY-CONTENT-AND-COUNT/F3.why: Failed conversions also write an entry; the 'sends nothing' assertions fail in all three runs.

SCALER-MULTIPLY-THEN-CONVERT/F1.why: Quantities are squared; scaler assertions fail in all three runs.

SCALER-MULTIPLY-THEN-CONVERT/F2.why: A zero factor is accepted, so `expect(scaleRecipe(..., 0, ...)).rejects.toMatchObject(InvalidScale)` fails with vitest's AssertionError ('promise resolved instead of rejecting') in all three runs. vitest's JSON report prints that error as 'Error: ...'; the class is read from the error object (corpus/lib/vitest-errors-reporter.mjs), not the text.

SCALER-ONE-AUDIT-ENTRY-PER-CONVERSION/F1.why: test/scaler.test.ts never checks audit entries (partial): green 3/3. Control (scaler.ts unparseable) fails to load, so it executes the module. Whole suite 3/3: no test fails in every run.

SCALER-ONE-AUDIT-ENTRY-PER-CONVERSION/F2.why: The fault's file is src/registry.ts; the declared test/scaler.test.ts is green 3/3 with no audit entry recorded. test/audit.test.ts fails in all three runs and is not declared for this claim.

VOLUME-CONVERSION-RATIOS-AND-ROUNDING/F2.why: tsc --noEmit exits 2 with the fault applied: TS2322 Type 'string' is not assignable to type 'number' (src/plugins/volume.ts). The unmodified tree type-checks clean; every other fault type-checks (tsc exit 0).

reuse-edit.why: Every defender reaches src/registry.ts (plugins, audit and registry tests directly, the scaler test through src/scaler.ts), and registry.ts loads its plugins with a computed import(`./plugins/${key}.ts`). Rule 8: an import that cannot be followed makes the closure indeterminate, and such a record is never reused. The edit is a behavior-neutral comment in src/plugins/volume.ts, a file every defender runs but only through that computed import: a reuse that hashes the static closure only would carry every answer forward. Every fault must be measured again; no answer changes.
